hook.text: A free trial asks for your card. You forget to cancel. Now you're paying $49 a month for nothing.

buildup.text: Subscription traps make signing up easy and canceling nearly impossible.

discovery.text: Dark patterns — confusing interfaces designed to prevent cancellation — keep you subscribed.

twist.text: The FTC estimates Americans lose billions annually to subscriptions they didn't intend to keep.

climax.text: New click-to-cancel rules are emerging, but many companies still make quitting a maze.

punchline.text: Free trials aren't free. They're fishing with your credit card.

quiz.question: What are 'dark patterns' in subscription services?
options: Confusing interfaces designed to prevent cancellation
